why_3x2: Names fit on one line at body (14) in a 148 px tile - 6x1 tiles would be 68 px wide and every name would need 2 lines at caption.
Each tile keeps a full 64x56 image slot above its name.
The d-pad moves in 2D, 3 steps at most, and the 1-2-2 strike order reads across two short rows.
It fits between the cards and the status strip with the kit lift.

rules: Draw order: tiles 0-5, the hovered or picked tile last.
Strikes: P1's mark is the cross (ico_strike_x) in P1 colour, P2's the barred ring (ico_strike_o) in P2 colour, and the tab names the player - shape, label and colour all differ.
Ban: the padlock (ico_lock) in the banning player's colour, tab names them. Picked: gold, lifted, check tab.
Stage images come from the disc later: the art quad is optional.
